subject: [RFC PATCH v3 01/14] mm/memcontrol: Introduce cgroup.memory=tiered_limits boot parameter

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new boot parameter 'cgroup.memory=tiered_limits' that enables tier-proportional scaling and enforcement of memory cgroup controller limits. The feature is incompatible with cgroup v1 and raises a warning if a system booted with tiered limits mounts a legacy cgroup. A static key is used to minimize overhead for cgroups not using tier-aware-memcg limits, which will become a hotpath in later commits. The patch adds code to enable the feature at boot time only, as flipping the bit at runtime could lead to uncharged or unchargeable folios.
